assignments.brief_reason: Controversy attributed to one-sidedness, not to threats/toxicity or consistent standards across sides.
Meta goal to prevent 'shit slinging' but no clear threats/toxicity or violence exception framing.
Removal tied to violence/harm toward persons or groups.
Rejects posts when demeaning content undermines argument advancement (toxicity/insult).
Personal attacks and vulgarity are leading factors for rejection.
Distinguishes productive argument vs attacks/name-calling as basis for removal.
Decisions based on perceived reasonableness/education/credibility rather than threat/toxicity triggers.
Focus is on balancing views with appropriate language, not explicit violence/toxicity thresholds.
Foul language leads to not supporting posts.
Profanity changes their thinking about civility, reflecting a toxicity/language consideration.
Judges based on believability of a typical audience/speaker plausibility, not threat/toxicity or equal moderation across sides.
Rejects rude/condescending/argumentative content to keep discussion civil.
Removes based on mean-spiritedness vs helpful/useful language (toxicity/civility).
Strategy to downweight politics and interpret intent/tone (venting) rather than explicit moderation thresholds.
Stays bipartisan and rejects only outright attacks/degrading comments (attack/toxic content removal).
Removes vulgar and conspiracy/unfactual content as grounds for rejection.
Declines low-quality combative content; includes affective annoyance tied to opposition party.
Explicit keep/remove distinction: remove insulting/demeaning, allow constructive criticism.
Distinguishes misinformation/falsity vs speech framing; not clearly about violence/threat or general toxicity bar.
Main influence is wording/tone (civil/educational vs accusatory), aligning with toxicity/civility moderation.
